story.title: Ola Electric Pumps Rs 2,000 Crore Into EV and Battery Manufacturing to Boost Localisation
story.summary: Ola Electric Mobility has approved a Rs 2,000 crore capital infusion into its EV and battery cell manufacturing subsidiaries as part of a push to deepen localisation and vertical integration across its supply chain. The investment is aimed at strengthening the company's core two-wheeler EV business and scaling battery production at a time of intensifying competition from legacy players and new entrants. The move comes as Ola Electric faces profitability pressure and scrutiny over after-sales service quality.
